description.value:
Requirement You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

Doors are a suggestion, made by somebody who had never met you.

Strike an unattended object, door, wall, or other barrier. Ignore up to 5 points of its Hardness, and on a hit you may immediately attempt to Force Open it, using your Strike's attack roll in place of the Athletics check. On a critical hit it opens, breaks, or comes off its hinges outright unless it is reinforced by magic or by something stranger.

cinderfall.incomplete: Strike an unattended object/door/wall/barrier, ignoring up to 5 points of its Hardness; on a hit, use the Strike's attack roll in place of the Athletics check for Force Open; on a critical hit it breaks outright. The skill-substitution clause matches real precedent (Courtly Graces / Determined Dash's Athletics-for-Balance clause, both rules: []) and needs no rule element, but "ignore up to 5 points of Hardness" is a real, stated numeric effect with no matching hook -- no rule-element key subtracts or bypasses an arbitrary struck object's own Hardness value (only granting resistance/hardness to the actor's own gear exists; nothing reaches an external object's stat block).
